cohort: 100 low-risk women with spontaneous onset of labor at term, singleton fetus in cephalic presentation, intact amniotic membranes, and cervical dilatation between 4 and 5 cm, at Mymensingh Medical College & Hospital, Bangladesh
finding: Amniotomy significantly reduced the duration of the first stage of labor without affecting the oxytocin requirement, the rate of cesarean section, or newborn outcome.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 9% of infants
